scripts.build: node scripts/cleanup-server-processes.js --quiet && cd web && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.verify:core: npm run verify:smoke && cd server && node scripts/verify-ai-muse-tools.js && node scripts/verify-agent-autonomy.js
scripts.verify:smoke: npm run verify:ui && npm run smoke:newspaper
scripts.verify:newspaper: npm run build && npm run smoke:newspaper
scripts.verify:ui: npm run build && npm run smoke:ui
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.openteams:prepare: cd integrations/openteams && corepack pnpm run generate-types && corepack pnpm run prepare-db
scripts.openteams:build:frontend: cd integrations/openteams/frontend && corepack pnpm run build
scripts.openteams:build:desktop: cd integrations/openteams && corepack pnpm run desktop:build
